preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two lines: first line is integer n, second line is string s of length n.
The first line is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 65000), and the second line is a string s of length n composed only of digits 1-9.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '123456789' for c in stdin.splitlines()[1])
preconditions.description: Every character in s is a digit from 1 to 9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for l in range(n) for r in range(l, n) if int(s[l:r+1]) % 2 == 0))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all substrings s[l..r] (1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n) where the integer represented by the substring is even. The count includes all possible (l, r) pairs, even if substrings are identical as strings.
